summary: fractal-web loads the selected conversation, retains bounded live follows, reports sync state, and reconciles optimistic sends without duplicate messages.

compatibility.detail: Client data and SDK changes only; no server protocol change. Send and Resend are explicit client operations. Person-authored mailbox headers are suppressed only when their st-minted content pair is in the window; separate agent mail and header-only mail remain visible. Echo reconciliation still reads the underlying message identities. Rejected rows produce typed diagnostics without row content.

manual.detail: No installation action required. Conversation follows and pending sends remain in memory.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
